fields.description: Lavita is a collection of six- and seven-bedroom mansions at The Oasis. Emaar’s launch material describes 43 homes beside waterways and gardens, with substantial family accommodation and separate entertaining and service areas. The architecture combines broad glazed openings with stone, timber and metal finishes.

overview: Lavita’s brochure sets out four architectural identities: Ayanna, Aman, Naya and Faya. Its interior palette uses marble, timber, glass and warm metal tones, with large windows intended to bring daylight into principal rooms. The community plan places a centre, lagoon and entrance facilities around the mansion enclave. These are design proposals; the final contracted specification governs each home.
research.locationNote: Lavita is in The Oasis, Dubai, close to Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road (D54). Emaar refers to a future E44 extension and connections to Dubai Hills, Arabian Ranches and Downtown. Published travel times vary between documents and should be checked on the actual route.
research.priceNote: The current Emaar page displays AED 36m. The launch fact sheet gives AED 36.61m for six bedrooms and AED 54.77m for seven; Property Finder lists higher launch references. These differently dated figures are not an available-unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The dated launch schedule is 20% booking, 60% across six stages and 20% at completion. The Emaar-branded fact and payment sheets are hosted by a broker. Confirm terms applying to any remaining or resale home.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment sheet estimates December 2028; Property Finder reports January 2029. The published dates do not align, so the current contractual completion date needs confirmation.

facts.label: Launch mix
facts.value: 43 mansions: 26 six-bedroom and 17 seven-bedroom homes. Fact-sheet average built-up areas are 19,099 and 28,039 sq ft respectively.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Plan totals combine the labelled floor areas, including basements; they are not plot sizes. The smaller mansion plans show three levels, while the medium mansions add a roof floor.

facts.label: Ayanna layout
facts.value: The reviewed M1-A plans include a car gallery, cinema, gym, hammam, sauna, entertainment room, office, guest suite, staff spaces, lift and roof lounge. These details belong to this layout.

facts.label: Materials
facts.value: The brochure presents marble surfaces, timber joinery, glass and brass/bronze-toned metal details; it does not establish a final supplier schedule.

unresolved: The brochure’s 21,000–35,500 sq ft range does not state its measurement basis and differs from the detailed plans. It is not used as the floor-area range.

Mitchells reports larger later-release plan totals: 20,024.94–20,096.42 sq ft for six bedrooms and 28,660.07–29,915.35 sq ft for seven. Revised sheets were not obtained here; confirm which edition belongs to the chosen plot.
Property Finder labels M1-A as Aman, but the official plan identifies it as Ayanna. Official naming is retained.

Current stock, actual plot size, final pool/landscaping inclusions, fit-out, parking allocation and charges require confirmation. Neither launch counts nor a portal’s sold-out label establishes availability.
Current images remain illustrative; project photography is deferred.
